questions.question: Let n be the number obtained on rolling a fair die. If the probability that the system x - ny + z = 6; x + (n-2)y + (n+1)z = 8; (n-1)y + z = 1 has a unique solution is k/6, then the sum of k and all possible values of n is:
questions.solution: Determinant ≠ 0 gives n² - 3n + 2 ≠ 0 ⇒ n ≠ 1,2. So unique solution for n = 3,4,5,6, giving P = 4/6, so k = 4. Required sum = 4 + (3+4+5+6) = 22.

questions.question: If the mean deviation about the median of the numbers k, 2k, 3k, ..., 1000k is 500, then k² is equal to:
questions.solution: Median = 1001k/2. Mean deviation about median = 500k/2 = 500 ⇒ k = 2 ⇒ k² = 4.

questions.question: The number of elements in the relation R = {(x,y) : 4x² + y² < 52, x,y ∈ Z} is
questions.solution: Counting integer pairs for x = 0,±1,±2,±3 gives 15+26+22+14 = 77.

questions.question: Let S = {z ∈ C : 4z² + z̄ = 0}. Then Σ_{z∈S} |z|² is equal to:
If lim(x→0) [e^((a-1)x) + 2cos(bx) + (c-2)e^(-x)] / [x cos x - log_e(1+x)] = 2, then a² + b² + c² is equal to:
questions.solution: Expanding series and matching coefficients: c = -1, a = -2, b² = 2. So a² + b² + c² = 4 + 2 + 1 = 7.

questions.question: If y = y(x) satisfies the given differential equation involving 16(√(x+9√x))(4+√(9+√x)) cos y dy = (1+2sin y)dx, x>0, and y(256) = π/2, y(49) = α, then 2 sin α is equal to:
questions.answer: Dropped by JEE (equation printed incorrectly; correct form gives 2sinα = 2√2 - 1)
questions.solution: Provided equation as printed is incorrect (√(x·√x + 9x) should replace √(x+9√x)); question dropped by JEE. With corrected equation, solving gives 2sinα + 1 = 2√2, so 2sinα = 2√2 - 1.

questions.question: Among the statements — (S1): If A(5,-1) and B(-2,3) are two vertices of a triangle whose orthocentre is (0,0), then its third vertex is (-4,-7). (S2): If positive numbers 2a, b, c are three consecutive terms of an A.P., then the lines ax+by+c=0 are concurrent at (2,-2).
questions.solution: Statement 1: using orthocentre perpendicularity conditions, third vertex = (-4,-7) — correct. Statement 2: 2a-2b+c=0 matches line family through (2,-2) — correct.

questions.question: Let a = 2î - ĵ + k̂ and b = λĵ + 2k̂, λ ∈ Z be two vectors. Let c = a × b and d be a vector of magnitude 2 in yz-plane. If |c| = √53, then the maximum possible value of (c·d)² is equal to:
questions.solution: Solving 5λ²+4λ-33=0 gives λ=-3 (integer), c = î - 4ĵ - 6k̂. Maximizing (4y+6z)² with y²+z²=4 gives max = (4²+6²)(y²+z²) = 52×4 = 208.

questions.question: If X = [X,Y,Z]^T is a solution of the system of equations AX=B, where adj A = [[4,2,2],[-5,0,5],[1,-2,3]] and B = [4,0,2]^T, then |x+y+z| is equal to:

Let L be the line (x+1)/2 = (y+1)/3 = (z+3)/6 and let S be the set of all points (a,b,c) on L, whose distance from the line (x+1)/2 = (y+1)/3 = (z-9)/0 along the line L is 7. Then Σ(a,b,c)∈S (a+b+c) is equal to:
questions.solution: Intersection point M(3,5,9). Solving PM=7 gives K=1,3, points (1,2,3) and (5,8,15); sum of all coordinates = 34.

questions.question: Let P(10, 2√15) be a point on the hyperbola x²/a² - y²/b² = 1, whose foci are S and S'. If the length of its latus rectum is 8, then the square of the area of ΔPSS' is equal to:
questions.solution: Using the point on hyperbola and latus rectum = 8, solve for a=5, b²=20; hyperbola x²/25 - y²/20 = 1. Focal length SS' = 6√5. Area = 30√3, so square of area = 2700.

questions.question: The area of the region A = {(x,y) : 4x²+y² ≤ 8 and y² ≤ 4x} is:
questions.solution: Integrating the two curves' bounded region gives area = π + 2/3 sq units.

questions.question: Let α, β be the roots of the quadratic equation 12x² - 20x + 3λ = 0, λ ∈ Z. If 1/2 ≤ |β-α| ≤ 3/2, then the sum of all possible values of λ is:
questions.solution: Using (α+β)² - 4αβ bounds gives 19/36 ≤ λ ≤ 91/36, so λ = 1,2; sum = 3.

questions.question: Let the domain of the function f(x) = log₃log₅(7 - log₂(x²-10x+85)) + sin⁻¹(|3x-7|/|17-x|) be (α, β]. Then α+β is equal to:
questions.solution: Domain from first term: x ∈ (3,7); from second term: x ∈ [-5,6]. Combined domain: (3,6]. α=3, β=6, α+β=9.

questions.question: Let [•] denote the greatest integer function, and let f(x) = min{√2x, x²}. Let S = {x ∈ (-2,2) : the function g(x) = |x|[x²] is discontinuous at x}. Then Σ_{x∈S} f(x) equals:
questions.solution: Points of discontinuity: S = {-1,1,-√2,√2,-√3,√3}. Sum of f(x) over S = -√2+1-2+2-√6+√6 = 1-√2.

questions.question: Let S and S' be the foci of the ellipse x²/25 + y²/9 = 1 and P(α,β) be a point on the ellipse in the first quadrant. If (SP)² + (S'P)² - SP·S'P = 37, then α²+β² is equal to:
questions.solution: PS+PS'=10; using (PS+PS')²-3PS·PS'=37 gives PS·PS'=21, leading to α²=25/4, β²=27/4, so α²+β²=13.

questions.question: Let the locus of the mid-point of the chord through the origin O of the parabola y²=4x be the curve S. Let P be any point on S. Then the locus of the point, which internally divides OP in the ratio 3:1, is:
questions.solution: Locus of midpoint of chord: y²=2x (curve S). Locus of point dividing OP in ratio 3:1 gives 2y²=3x.

options: f(x)=0 for finitely many values of x

questions.question: Let f and g be functions satisfying f(x+y)=f(x)f(y), f(1)=7 and g(x+y)=g(xy), g(1)=1, for all x,y∈N. If Σ_{x=1}^{n} f(x)/g(x) = 19607, then n is equal to:
questions.solution: f(x)=7^x, g(x)=1 for all x. Σ7^x = 19607 gives 7^n = 16807, so n=5.

questions.question: Let Cr denote the coefficient of x^r in the binomial expansion of (1+x)^n. If Pn = C0 - C1 + (2²/3)C2 - (2³/4)C3 + ... + ((-2)^n/(n+1))Cn, then the value of Σ_{n=1}^{25} 1/P_{2n} equals.

Let a vector a = √2 î - ĵ + λk̂, λ>0, make an obtuse angle with the vector b = -λ²î + 4√2ĵ + 4√2k̂ and an angle θ, π/6<θ<π/2, with the positive z-axis. If the set of all possible values of λ is (α,β) - {γ}, then α+β+γ is equal to ____.
questions.solution: From angle condition λ∈(0,3); from obtuse angle condition λ≠2. So λ∈(0,3)-{2}, giving α=0, β=3, γ=2, α+β+γ=5.

questions.question: Let [•] be the greatest integer function. If α = ∫₀⁶⁴ (x^(1/3) - [x^(1/3)]) dx, then (1/π)∫₀^{απ} sin²θ/(sin⁶θ+cos⁶θ) dθ is equal to ____.
questions.solution: ∫₀⁶⁴x^(1/3)dx=192, ∫₀⁶⁴[x^(1/3)]dx=156, so α=36. Evaluating the trigonometric integral gives J=π/2, and final expression E=36.

questions.question: Let cos(α+β) = -1/10 and sin(α-β) = 3/8, where 0<α<π/3 and 0<β<π/4. If tan2α = 3(1-r√5)/[√11(s+√5)], r,s∈N, then r+s is equal to ____.
questions.solution: Using tan2α = tan[(α+β)+(α-β)] and computing tan(α+β), tan(α-β), simplifying gives tan2α = 3(1-11√5)/[√11(9+√5)]. So r=11, s=9, r+s=20.

questions.question: Suppose a,b,c are in A.P. and a², 2b², c² are in G.P. If a<b<c and a+b+c=1, then 9(a²+b²+c²) is equal to ____.
questions.solution: b=1/3, and solving 4b⁴=a²c² gives d²=1/3, d=1/√3 (since a<b<c). Then 9(a²+b²+c²) = 9[1/3+2/3] = 9.

questions.question: Let S be the set of the first 11 natural numbers. Then the number of elements in A = {B⊆S : n(B)≥2 and the product of all elements of B is even} is ____.
questions.solution: Total subsets = 2¹¹ = 2048. Subtract subsets with only odd elements (2⁶=64, includes null set) and subsets with exactly one element that is even (5). Answer = 2048-64-5 = 1979.
